player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop by repeatedly guessing the same word, "theme", which is close but not the correct answer. What's worse, I didn't make any progress towards the correct word after the first few attempts. Next time, I will make sure to analyze the feedback from each guess and use it to inform my next guess. I will also try to introduce new letters and avoid repeating the same word. For example, after the first guess, "house", I should have noticed that "e" is a green letter and tried to build upon that. I will also pay closer attention to the letters that are in the wrong position, like "h" and "o", and try to use them in a more strategic way.
